preconditions.description: The input grid is a square matrix (N x N) where N is the number of rows and columns.
The grid size N satisfies 1 ≤ N ≤ 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost <= 1000 for row in grid for cost in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell cost in the grid is an integer between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(sum(grid[i][j] for i, j in path) for path in valid_paths(grid))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum total cost of any valid path from the top-left cell (0,0) to the bottom-right cell (N-1,N-1), where a valid path is a sequence of adjacent cells (up, down, left, right) without revisiting cells.
